title: Slapsgiving 2: Revenge of the Slap
cn: 第 9 集 · 掌掴感恩节2：复仇之掌
novel:
Marshall had one slap left to deliver, and Thanksgiving was the perfect stage. He [[prepared|prepare]] for days, stretching his hand, studying the [[angle|angle]] of impact.

But the day brought an unexpected guest: Lily's [[estranged|estranged]] father, Mickey. He had missed every important moment of her life, and now he showed up with a [[turkey|turkey]] and a guilty smile.

Lily was [[furious|furious]]. "You can't just [[waltz|waltz]] in after ten years," she said.

Mickey [[stammered|stammer]] an apology. The room fell silent.

Marshall saw his chance. He told Mickey that if he wanted to stay, he had to accept a [[slap|slap]]. Mickey agreed, thinking it was a joke.

It was not. Marshall [[delivered|deliver]] the slap with [[legendary|legendary]] force — only it landed on Barney, who had [[sneaked|sneak]] up to steal the turkey. Chaos [[erupted|erupt]].

By the end of the night, Lily had not [[forgiven|forgive]] her father, but she had let him stay. And Barney, nursing a red cheek, [[vowed|vow]] [[revenge|revenge]].

angle.en: the direction from which something comes

estranged.en: no longer close to your family

turkey.en: a large bird eaten on Thanksgiving

waltz.en: to enter somewhere confidently as if you belong

stammer.en: to speak with many pauses and repeated sounds

slap.en: a blow with the flat of your hand

deliver.en: to do what you promised; to give a blow

legendary.en: famous and talked about for a long time

sneak.en: to move quietly so no one sees you

forgive.en: to stop being angry with someone

revenge.en: something you do to hurt someone who hurt you
